How the comparison works

Gold exchange cost = Royal Crystals × gold per 238 Royal Crystals ÷ 238.
Extra value = (reward value ÷ gold exchange cost − 1) × 100.
Saving versus market = (1 − gold exchange cost ÷ reward value) × 100.

Example: getting 400,000 gold of useful materials for Royal Crystals worth 300,000 gold means 33.3% extra value, or a 25% saving versus buying those materials. Neither figure means the bound rewards can be sold for gold.

Ticket values represent average reward estimates; actual rewards vary and require completing the content. Ebony Cube tickets use a proportional value of 35,000 gold each (3 tickets → 1 Epic Hell Key). A remainder needs other tickets to complete an exchange. Elysian tickets are excluded. Exchange calculations use the displayed gold-to-Royal-Crystal rate.
